TWO SEPARATE REQUIREMENTS, and both must hold. FIRST, THE GARMENT: build the feature at exactly the size the drawing gives it — no larger. Getting one of these right while getting the other wrong is still a failure: an accurate feature shot at the wrong distance, or a matched frame containing an exaggerated feature, both mislead a customer comparing two pictures side by side.
